people.imagined: Cocks his head toward the hill while others speak; he swears he hears only the wind.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a mossy hillside he turns his head sharply to listen toward the dark slope, then glances at the viewer with wide, innocent eyes, swearing he hears only the wind. Face (the head cocked sharply to one side, ear toward the hill): a plain, narrow, careful face with wary dark eyes, a thin mouth, a freckled nose, one eyebrow raised, large ears, a faint blush of fear on the cheeks and a pine needle caught in his hair. Hair: black and uneven, pinned up crookedly with a plain jade pine-twig hairpin that has slipped to one side. Body: slim, stringy and tense, shoulders hunched. Clothing: the simplest graceful silk of an outer disciple, a single-layer robe of pale bark-cream silk with a soft pine-green crossed collar, narrow pine-needle embroidery in darker green along the hem, a plain green cord for a belt with the hem tied up out of the way, and a small woodcutter's hatchet in a sheath stitched crookedly at his hip. Hands and objects: one hand lifted behind his ear as if cupping it; the other holds a pine nut. Background: a dark hill of tall pines in drifting blue mist with a faint path winding up it, a small pale moon rising above the ridge. Light: cool moonlight from the upper left that leaves half his face in shadow, with a soft silver rim along his ear and the pine nut shining in his palm. Expression: a shifty innocence, the eyes wide and the mouth too straight, a loyal, cautious boy who has learned that the safest answer is that he heard nothing.

people.imagined: She walks murmuring the roll under her breath, her thin straight nose lifted, her knees still sore from the pine cones.
people.subject: The moment: walking along a moonlit corridor, her lips moving silently as she recites the roll under her breath, eyes straight ahead and then flicking to the viewer, her knees still sore from kneeling on pine cones. Face (a thin straight nose, the clan's, and moving lips): a pale, narrow, proud face with a long thin straight nose, narrow dark eyes, a firm mouth shaping words and a tiny line of effort between the brows. Hair: black, in a tight high bun held by two slim white-jade pins. Body: slim, upright and stiff. Clothing: the plain, graceful silk of an outer disciple, a neat and exact two-layer robe of pale bark-cream silk with a crossed pine-green collar, a thin border of darker green wind-curl embroidery at the cuffs, a slim cord belt tied in an exact knot, a faint stain of pine resin at each knee, and a small bamboo slip hung at the hip on a green tassel. Hands and objects: both hands clasped behind her back; the bamboo slip swings at the belt. Background: a long stone corridor of pale pillars dissolving into soft mist, a single paper lamp glowing far down the passage. Light: cool silver spirit-light from the upper left that gives her face a waxen paleness, the lamp a small warm star behind her. Expression: an exact, recitation face, the lips shaping each syllable and the eyes cold with ambition, a diligent girl whose memory is her weapon and who has not forgotten a slight.

people.imagined: She raises two fingers to her lips to blow a two-note whistle so a whole field looks up; she waves signal flags along the sluices.
people.subject: The moment: on a bright morning at the edge of a flooded field she puts two fingers to her lips and blows a sharp whistle, cheeks puffed, eyes bright on the viewer, a signal flag raised in the other hand. Face: a strong, open, sunburnt face, bright hazel eyes, thick brows, a wide mouth puckered, freckles, a stray curl at the temple, rosy cheeks and a faint line of dirt on the chin. Hair: brown, in a loose braid tied with a green silk cord, a jade pine-twig pin at the crown. Body: lithe and sturdy. Clothing: a light outer-disciple jacket of pale bark-cream silk with a soft pine-green crossed collar and short wide sleeves rolled to the elbow, needle-green silk sash, rolled trousers and bare feet in the wet mud; the hem is embroidered with a thin border of darker green wind-curls and a bundle of spare flags is tied at her back. Hands and objects: a bright green silk signal flag on a short pole in the left hand, raised high; two fingers of the right hand at her lips. Background: a green lowland of flat paddies and long ditches under a wide pearly sky, a line of white birds in flight and a drift of low mist over the water. Light: bright, luminous morning light from the upper left, the mist glowing, the green flag shining and her freckles warmed. Expression: bright wide eyes over puffed cheeks mid-whistle, an open, honest face full of energy.

people.imagined: One eyebrow lifts by itself when she listens; she can chant the primer backwards and has been told to stop.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in a quiet hall in the hush before the chant, her head tilted and her left eyebrow raised high on its own, she looks at the viewer with gentle curiosity; she can chant the primer backwards and has been told to stop. Face (a single eyebrow arched high, the other level): a soft, mild, round face with a high arched left brow, a level right brow, calm attentive brown eyes, a small gentle closed mouth and a faint dimple that appears when she listens. Hair: black, in a long single braid bound with a green silk ribbon and a small jade pine-twig pin. Body: slim and quiet, kneeling with an easy straight back. Clothing: an inner-disciple robe of two soft layers, pale bark-cream silk under a pine-green gauze over-layer with crossed collars, wide sleeves hanging in soft folds, darker green pine-needle embroidery along the borders, and a needle-green silk sash tied in a bow with neat ends, a small green jade pine-cone pendant at her waist. Hands and objects: both hands folded in her lap; a small wooden clapper rests beside her knee. Power: a faint wood-green shimmer of qi motes drifts slowly near her ear, as if the room were murmuring to her. Background: a hall of tall pale pillars in soft shadow and mist, a thin beam of silver light on the floor mat beside her. Light: soft, cool spirit-light from the upper left resting on her face and the raised brow. Expression: a mild, devout attention, the head tilted and the left brow lifting by itself, humble and patient, the look of a girl who hears more than she says and does not know it is unusual.

people.imagined: Head cook at the stove with a ladle pointed like a sword at the person who asked twice; she has cooked without an open flame for sixty years.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a steaming kitchen behind a big black pot, a mortal servant of the palace, she fixes the viewer with a firm, half-amused glare and a pointing weapon of a kitchen tool. Face (a ladle pointed at the viewer, large and in the foreground): a broad, red-cheeked, strong-featured old face with deep laugh lines, small shrewd black eyes, a big nose, a stern but generous mouth, a double chin and a floury cheek. Hair: grey, tied up in a clean white cloth with a pine-green ribbon. Body: stout, wide and formidable, with thick floury forearms. Clothing: a servant's tunic, plainer than any disciple's but clean and handsome, of soft undyed linen in pale bark-cream with a pine-green crossed collar and a darker green border of small pine needles at the cuffs, a big white apron over it with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, and a ring of keys on a green cord at her belt; no sash of rank. Hands and objects: the long iron ladle held out at arm's length, tip toward the lens like a drawn sword; the steaming pot at her back. Background: a kitchen of hanging copper pans and pots, steam rising to the beams in pale clouds, a covered stove glowing red with coals but with no open flame. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left, the steam catching it like mist, a bright gleam running along the ladle and her shining cheeks. Expression: a firm, half-amused glare with one eyebrow raised and a creased, weathered mouth about to scold, an old woman who has fed a palace for sixty years and fears no one.

people.imagined: Warp-strings knotted round both wrists, she sits at the loom and knows every robe by its sleeve; a second bolt is quietly hidden.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a tall loom in the pale light of a weaving room, a mortal servant of the palace, she looks up at the viewer with a guarded face, warp-strings looped round both wrists. Face: a narrow, withdrawn, lined face with sharp dark eyes, a thin mouth, a crease between the brows, pale skin and a fleck of lint on the cheek. Hair: grey-black, in a tight bun under a clean pale cloth bound with a green cord. Body: spare, with bent shoulders and thin, rough fingers. Clothing: a servant's tunic, plainer than a disciple's but clean and fine, of soft undyed bark-cream linen with a narrow pine-green crossed collar and a thin darker green border of pine needles at the cuffs, a brown weaving apron with a row of pins in the bib, short sleeves, and a bobbin hung on a cord round her neck; no sash of rank. Hands and objects: thick bands of knotted warp-strings wound round both wrists like bracelets and trailing down, the skin beneath them marked; a shuttle in one hand; behind her the loom holds half-woven pale bark-linen cloth that glints faintly like silk. Background: a weaving room of soft shadow, bolts of pale cloth piled on shelves and rows of bobbins catching small points of light. Light: soft silvery light from a window at the upper left, so fine threads show in the air like drifting mist and a pale rim edges her profile. Expression: a guarded, closed face with lowered lids and narrowed eyes that give nothing away, lips pressed, a woman who knows every robe by its sleeve and keeps one bolt quietly hidden.

people.imagined: Bark flakes fall from his beard as he nods, driving his cart a day out of the way to avoid a fresh stump.
people.subject: The moment: sitting on a cart bench in the grey mist of a pine track, a mortal servant of the palace, he holds the reins and nods slowly to the viewer while bark flakes fall from his beard, having driven a day out of the way to avoid a fresh stump. Face (a thick bushy grey-brown beard full of tiny bark flakes and sawdust): a broad, weathered, calm face with a heavy brow, small deep-set eyes, a big flat nose, thick ears, a very full grey-brown beard flecked with bark, and bark flakes lying in the lines of his brow. Hair: grey, short and thick, under a plain pale cloth cap. Body: thick, strong and slow, broad shoulders with bark dust on them. Clothing: a servant's long tunic, plainer than any disciple's but clean, of soft undyed bark-cream linen over a pine-green vest, a narrow crossed collar, a darker green wind-curl border at the hem and cuffs, sleeves rolled, a plain green cord belt, and dark boots; no sash of rank. A leather strap round one wrist holds the reins. Hands and objects: reins in both hands; behind him a great fallen log lashed on the cart. Background: a forest track running between enormous pines, fallen trunks furred with moss beside it, a patient ox standing in the traces, pale mist hanging between the trunks. Light: soft silver light from the upper left falling through the mist, picking out the pale bark chips as they drift down like motes. Expression: a calm, slow, stubborn gravity, the eyes steady and the mouth hidden in the beard, a devout man who will go any distance rather than harm a tree.

people.imagined: Surfacing from a pearl dive, she holds up her wrinkled fingertips and a bag, smiling like someone who has already got away with it.
people.subject: The moment: just surfaced from a pearl dive in a bright green lake, hair streaming, she holds up a small net bag and her free hand with pruned fingertips, smiling at the viewer like someone who has already got away with it. Face (wrinkled, pruned fingertips on the raised hand, spread wide): a bright, clever, wet face with strong cheekbones, sharp dark eyes, thin level brows, a quick sly smile, water running from her chin, pale blue lips from the cold, spiky lashes, and a small gap between her front teeth. Hair: black and wet, plastered to her head and neck, a small jade pin gleaming in it. Body: lithe, with strong shoulders, wet. Clothing: a thin, clinging diving jacket of pale bark-cream silk gone translucent-dark with water, a pine-green crossed collar, a needle-green silk sash wound twice and knotted at the waist, bare arms, and a small knife on a cord at her hip. Hands and objects: the right hand raised with fingers visibly shrivelled and wrinkled white; the left holds a small dripping net bag with a few pale pearls showing. Power: a thin water-blue shimmer of qi runs over the surface of the lake around her shoulders, rings spreading outward. Background: a lake surface of green ripples with the prow of a small boat and other divers blurred in the shallows, a few bubbles rising. Light: bright light from the upper left glinting on the water and on every wet strand of hair, pearly spray in the air. Expression: a sly, triumphant smile with sparkling eyes and dripping hair, the look of someone who has got away with it.

people.imagined: He rolls along like a man always crossing ice, jaw working over something hidden under his tongue.
people.subject: The moment: on a frozen lake he walks with a wide, rolling, careful gait, looking at the viewer from the side with one cheek slightly bulged, like a man always crossing ice, jaw working over something hidden under his tongue. Face (a bulge in the cheek and a rolling wide-legged gait): a heavy-jawed, wind-reddened, stubborn face with small deceptive eyes, thick brows with a little white scar through the left one, a flat nose from an old break, thick tight lips pressed shut and red cheeks. Hair: black, in a short rough cut with a plain jade pine-twig pin. Body: stocky and thick-legged, balancing with his arms held out as if on ice. Clothing: a robe of pale bark-cream silk quilted for the cold under a thick grey-green gauze over-robe with a pine-green crossed collar and darker green pine-needle borders, a scarf of cream wool wound round his neck, no sash, and iron-spiked ice-cleats bound with leather over his boots. Hands and objects: both arms slightly out to the sides for balance; an ice-hook hanging from his belt on a green cord. Background: a frozen lake stretching into pale blue haze, a few black holes cut in the ice, a sled leaning on a post. Light: cold silver-blue light from the upper left leaving his red cheeks glowing, his breath hanging in a small cloud and the ice shining under his feet. Expression: a shut, stubborn, sideways look, the lips tight and the cheek bulging, impatient and shifty, pleased with a secret kept in his mouth.

people.imagined: Fletching feathers stuck in his belt like a tail; he says aloud what the Root Hall says in private.
people.subject: The moment: standing in an archery field at the golden hour with a bow over his shoulder and his chin raised, he speaks boldly to the viewer, saying aloud what the Root Hall says only in private. Face: a handsome, haughty, square-jawed face with bold dark eyes, strong brows, a thin moustache, a proud mouth, a straight thin nose, white teeth, a small scar on the chin and a tiny gold stud in the left ear. Hair: black, in a high tail bound with a green silk cord and a jade pine-twig hairpin. Body: tall, broad-shouldered and upright. Clothing (the feathers are the lead): a tailored inner-disciple coat of pine-green silk over a pale bark-cream under-robe with crossed collars, darker green pine-needle embroidery along the borders, a needle-green silk sash and a green jade pine-cone pendant; in his belt a fan of nine long grey fletching feathers sticks out behind like a bird's tail; bracers carved with a bow pattern and a fine quiver of dyed red leather. Hands and objects: a long bow wrapped at the grip with green cord, held in the left hand with its tip on the ground; the right thumb hooked in his belt. Power: faint wood-green motes drift off the bowstring and the feathers. Background: an archery field with straw targets in a long row, a rack of bows against a wall and a pale gold sky with thin cloud. Light: bright golden light from the upper left shining on the feathers and giving his hair a blue-black gloss. Expression: a bold, arrogant half-smile, the chin high and the eyes challenging, a man who enjoys being the first to say the thing others dare not.

people.imagined: On the dike at dusk he sings his father's name under his breath; he has his father's cleft chin and uses it when he is about to say nothing.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a dike at dusk, mouth closed, chin set and cleft, looking calmly at the viewer, the name of his father unsung on his lips. Face (a deep cleft in the chin, clear at the centre): a long, calm, severe face with a deep dimple-like cleft chin, dark steady eyes, level brows, a firm closed mouth, a pale line scar on the jaw and a shadow of stubble. Hair: black, in a plain knot with a green silk cord and a jade pine-twig pin. Body: tall, lean, quiet. Clothing: an inner-disciple robe of pale bark-cream silk with a pine-green gauze over-layer and crossed collars, darker green wind-curl embroidery at the borders, a needle-green silk sash and a green jade pine-cone pendant, the hem damp from the river, and over it a loose river-brown cloak pinned with a plain bone pin. Hands and objects: arms folded; a flood-mark chalk in one hand; a tally cord at the belt. Power: a faint water-blue haze of qi lies low along the ground at his feet, like the river breathing. Background: a stone dike running away to a dusk-pink horizon, a pale river, a few reeds bending by the water and a small boat moored. Light: gold dusk light from the upper left lighting half his face and leaving the cleft in his chin a deep shadow, a soft rim of light on his shoulder. Expression: steady, unreadable eyes under level brows, nothing given away.

people.imagined: A market girl with a copper on a string at her neck, delivering sealed letters, trusting and smiling.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a bright market lane, she holds a sealed letter in each hand and smiles trustingly at the viewer. Face (a single copper coin with a square hole hung on a string at her throat): a round, friendly, rosy face with big brown eyes, a snub nose, a wide cheerful mouth, a small mole at the corner of her lip, small white teeth and a few freckles across the nose. Hair: black, in two braids looped with green silk thread and a small jade pine-twig pin. Body: sturdy, small, brisk. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple, a light robe of pale bark-cream silk with a pine-green crossed collar, narrow wind-curl embroidery in darker green at the cuffs, a plain green cord belt, a bright blue market apron, a red satchel strap with a small bell sewn onto it, and a square-holed copper coin on a thin red string round her neck. Hands and objects: two letters folded and sealed with plain wax discs held in the right hand; a satchel on the left shoulder. Background: bright market awnings, stalls with coloured cloth, baskets of pears and strings of dried fish, a donkey at the edge, all in soft bokeh with lanterns strung overhead. Light: bright, warm, luminous morning light from the upper left, a gentle glow on her cheeks, the copper coin a spot of gold at her throat. Expression: an open, trusting smile with wide bright eyes and raised brows, friendly and unguarded.

people.imagined: A fresh bruise on his cheek like a medal; he has just cracked a rival's ribs after the bout and calls it manners.
people.subject: The moment: in a practice yard at hard morning, he stands with his chest out and his chin high, a swollen bruise on one cheek, looking down his nose at the viewer, having just cracked a rival's ribs and called it manners. Face (a big fresh purple-yellow bruise on the left cheek, worn proudly): a young sharp face with a thin proud nose, narrow bright eyes, a thin smile with a hint of cruelty, thick black brows, a swollen cheekbone in violet and yellow, a split lip, a narrow jaw and a gleam of pride in his small dark eyes. Hair: black, in a high tail bound with a green silk cord and a jade pine-twig pin. Body: lean, small for his arrogance, stiff-backed. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple, a crisp, freshly pressed two-layer robe of pale bark-cream silk with a pine-green crossed collar and a darker green wind-curl border, no sash, a bamboo practice-guard bound with green cord on one forearm and plain cloth shoes. Hands and objects: the knuckles of the right fist skinned, held at his side. Background: a packed-earth practice yard with a straw-wrapped post, a few older disciples watching from a veranda, blurred in pale morning mist. Light: hard, bright light from the upper left that makes the bruise stand out in violet and yellow, with a thin silver rim along his jaw. Expression: a haughty, jutting chin and a smirk, the eyes looking down the nose over a swollen cheek.

people.imagined: At the chimney furnace she stokes the fire, one eye red from smoke, eyebrows burnt to stubble, wanting the second furnace.
people.subject: The moment: crouched at the mouth of a chimney furnace with a poker, she looks over her shoulder at the viewer with a hard, ambitious stare, wanting the second furnace. Face (one red, swollen smoke-irritated eye, and eyebrows burnt to short stubble): a thin, sharp, sooty face, one eye reddened and weeping, the other black and keen, eyebrows singed to short bristles, singed lashes, a tight dry mouth and ash on her nose. Hair: black, tied in a high tail with a jade pin, the ends singed. Body: wiry, with strong forearms. Clothing: an inner-disciple robe of pale bark-cream silk smudged with soot under a pine-green gauze over-layer with crossed collars and darker green borders, a needle-green silk sash, a green jade pine-cone pendant, sleeves tied up with wet cloth bands, a scorched pill-maker's apron and a leather glove on the left hand. Hands and objects: an iron poker in her right hand, glowing orange at the tip; the left hand shielding her eyes. Power: faint red-gold sparks of fire qi drift up around the poker and her wrist, though her root is mostly wood. Background: a brick furnace mouth gaping with glowing coals, a tall black chimney climbing into smoke that glows at its edges, a shelf of clay jars. Light: orange furnace glow from the lower right dancing on the poker and her sweaty forehead, cool pale light from the upper left on her hair. Expression: a hard, hungry stare with narrowed red-rimmed eyes, singed brows and a clenched jaw.

people.imagined: He props a plank against his hip and sits to carve it; he cannot lift it. Another takes the credit and he does not mind.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a low stool with a long plank propped against his hip, carving with a small knife, he looks up at the viewer with a quiet smile; he cannot lift the plank, and another will take the credit for the work. Face: a thin, gentle, pale face with a narrow chin, soft dark eyes, a shy mouth, a freckle cluster on the nose, fine sawdust on his cheek and a smear of it in his hair. His fingers are long and scarred with small knife cuts. Hair: brown, in a small knot with a jade pine-twig pin. Body: slight, narrow, weak in the shoulders. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of an outer disciple, a soft robe of pale bark-cream silk with a pine-green crossed collar and a darker green pine-needle border, no sash, a grey carver's apron with a row of tiny pockets over it, sleeves rolled above thin elbows, and a small wooden mallet at his belt on a green cord. Hands and objects: a long pale plank leaning against his hip and held with one arm; the other hand carving a leaf pattern with a small knife. Power: a few faint wood-green motes rise from the fresh shavings as if the wood were exhaling. Background: a workshop of pale beams, planks stacked against the wall, a drift of curling shavings on the floor and a half-carved bird on a bench, all softened in warm haze. Light: soft light from the upper left showing the fine grain of the plank and the curl of a shaving, with a gentle glow along his cheek. Expression: a quiet, humble smile with lowered eyes lifting briefly, soft brows and a relaxed mouth.

people.imagined: On the road with mud to the knees and a bruise on his hip from the satchel, he opens the satchel at an inn and grins.
people.subject: The moment: seated on an inn step in lazy gold afternoon light, the satchel open on his knees, he peeks at a sealed letter and looks up at the viewer with a quick fickle grin, in from the road with mud to the knees and a bruise on his hip from the satchel. Face: a sunburnt, lively, boyish face with bright quick eyes, messy brows, a wide grin with crooked teeth and a gap, a small scar on the nose and a scrap of straw stuck in his tousled hair. Hair: brown and tousled, held by a jade pine-twig pin that is about to fall out. Body: lean and loose-limbed, sprawled on the step. Clothing: the simple graceful silk of an outer disciple, a travel jacket of pale bark-cream silk with a pine-green crossed collar, darker green wind-curl embroidery at the cuffs, trousers rolled and mud-caked to the knee, a needle-green silk sash hanging askew and scuffed boots; the leather satchel has a scuffed corner and has left a bruise-coloured mark on the cloth at his hip. Hands and objects: the satchel open on his knee with a folded sealed letter half out; the other hand on the strap. Background: an inn courtyard with a stone trough, a tethered horse and a brown dog watching the satchel, a haze of dust and gold light. Light: lazy gold afternoon light from the upper left that gleams on the folded letter and rims his tousled hair. Expression: a quick, fickle grin, the eyes darting to the letter and back to you, sociable and shameless, a messenger who treats every secret as a small entertainment.

people.imagined: He arrives in time for nothing; he has missed three ferries and a wedding. He sits with the scales on his knee and lends money kindly.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a great iron weighing scale in a resin warehouse, he smiles with kindly resignation at the viewer, one hand lifted in apology, having missed three ferries and a wedding. Face: a large, soft, bald-crowned, good-natured face with a double chin, half-moon eyes, thick grey brows, a small round nose, a gentle smile and an old man's pink cheeks; his hands are soft and ink-stained, his ears large, a trace of resin shining on his forefinger. Hair: sparse white hair at the sides, bald on top. Body: heavy, comfortable, a slow sitter. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of an old outer disciple, a soft robe of pale bark-cream silk washed to a gentle cream, with a faded pine-green crossed collar and darker green pine-needle borders, no sash, a weighing apron of grey linen with its strings tied in a loose bow, chalk marks on the sleeves and a small wooden abacus hung from the belt on a green cord. Hands and objects: the right hand raised in a slow apologetic wave; the left rests on the beam of the iron scale, one pan holding a lump of amber resin that glows like honey. Background: a high warehouse of barrels in rows with ladders and ropes, a little cart with a broken axle in the corner, golden dust in the air. Light: warm amber light from the upper left, soft with floating motes, settling kindly on his round face and glowing through the resin. Expression: a kindly, resigned smile with crinkled eyes and raised brows, apologetic and warm, a man who arrives in time for nothing and lends money gently.

people.imagined: On the north-shore cliffs he keeps a rolled-bark spyglass to his eye, counting skiffs; he never looks at anyone close by.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a high cliff edge in a cold wind with a rolled bark spyglass held to one eye, the other eye wide, he glances at the viewer once, counting skiffs and never looking at anyone close by. Face (a spyglass of rolled pale birch bark raised to the left eye, long and plain): a narrow, pale, tense face with a sharp nose, thin chapped lips, a worried crease, wind-reddened eyes and a faint ring pressed round the eye by the tube, one wide wary eye showing. Hair: black, tied back with a cord and a jade pin and blown loose by the wind. Body: thin, sharp-shouldered and rigid. Clothing: the plain graceful silk of an outer disciple, a pale bark-cream silk robe with a pine-green crossed collar and darker green wind-curl borders, a needle-green cord at the waist, a heavy cream cloak against the wind clasped with a bone pin that streams sideways like a banner, boots laced to the knee and a small leather case on the belt. A cord round his neck carries the spyglass when not in use. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the rolled bark tube to his eye; the left grips a cliff rock, the knuckles red with cold. Background: a high cliff dropping sheer to a grey-silver lake with tiny boats on it, clouds trailing across a pale sky. Light: cold, windy silver light from the upper left that strips the colour from everything except his red hands. Expression: a tight, wary, suspicious attention, the one visible eye wide and the mouth clamped, a loyal, solitary watcher who trusts distance more than people.

people.imagined: Dawn at the retreat. She stands straight and small, grey-green sash stirring though no wind blows, the wolf's tooth on its cord at her chest; she is listening to the pines for the fifteenth layer.
people.subject: The moment: at dawn on a stone step before her retreat she stands small and straight, head slightly tilted, listening to the pines for the fifteenth layer, and then turns her calm eyes to the viewer. Face (a sash lifting and stirring in still air, and a single wolf's tooth on a cord): a small, fine-boned old face, finely lined, cheeks soft, level pale grey eyes full of stillness, thin white brows, a mouth with a faint smile, skin pale and clear as jade. Hair: pure white, cut at the jaw in a straight line, crowned with a slender pine-twig crown of green jade and silver. Body: small, upright, light as a reed. Clothing: the richest robes of the palace, several flowing layers of pine-green and bark-cream brocade-silk under an over-robe of grey-green gauze with a long train of sleeves, collars crossed three times and heavily embroidered in darker green and silver with pine needles and wind-curls; a wide grey-green silk sash tied loosely at the waist whose ends lift sideways as if moved by a breeze though no wind blows; jade pendants chime at her hip. Hands and objects: both hands folded in her wide sleeves; at her chest on a thin cord a single curved yellowed wolf's tooth the length of a finger. Power: a visible wood-green aura of soft light and drifting leaf-shaped motes rises around her, with a fainter water-blue mist coiling at her hem, the pines leaning toward her. Background: tall dark pines in pale dawn mist, perfectly still. Light: soft gold dawn light from the upper left, a luminous rim around her white hair. Expression: calm, just and devout; gently listening, a woman the whole sect looks up to.

people.imagined: He walks the quay like a fisher on a wet deck, a seal of green stone hanging at his belt where a sword would. He wants the Cold Ford back.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a wet harbour quay with his feet planted wide as if on a deck, a thumb hooked in his belt beside a green stone seal, he looks at the viewer with stubborn authority, wanting the Cold Ford back. Face (a green stone seal hung at the belt, the size of a fist, and a broad weathered fisher's face): a broad, weathered, square face, deep wind-lines, a heavy nose, small hard black eyes, thick grey brows, a firm square jaw and a grey beard cropped short; his hands are broad with thick knuckles scarred by hooks and nets. Hair: grey, cropped short with a plain jade-ringed topknot. Body: wide, heavy, planted, with a rolling walk. Clothing: the rich robes of an elder of the Coiled Root Hall, a long coat of dark pine-green brocade-silk over bark-cream layers with crossed collars, a heavy grey-green gauze over-robe with wide sleeves, darker green pine-needle and wave embroidery at the borders, silver bracers over the cuffs and a broad grey-green silk sash. Hands and objects: a thick plain green jade seal the size of a fist hung by a braided green cord from the belt where a sword would be; one hand rests on it. Power: a deep wood-green glow of qi coils round him like river weed, with a cold water-blue mist rolling low across the stones at his boots. Background: wet stone steps leading down to dark water, a row of moored boats with furled brown sails, gulls, a drifting sea-mist. Light: pale pearl light from the upper left, the wet stones shining like pewter, a green gleam in the seal. Expression: a grim, steady face with a stubborn set to the jaw and firm unblinking eyes.

people.imagined: At noon she carries the abbey's green glass lamp, lit, because she has never been without it since the flood. River mud dries on her hem.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a dike at noon with a lit green glass lamp held at her hip, she looks quietly at the viewer, never having been without the abbey's lamp since the flood, river mud dried on her hem. Face (a small green glass lamp, lit and glowing, in the middle of the day): a thin, composed, pale face with a long fine nose, patient pale-grey eyes, a firm small mouth, fine lines at the corners of the eyes and a still gaze. Hair: black, in a plain low knot with a grey-green cord, a jade comb and a silver pine-twig pin. Body: thin, straight and narrow-shouldered, with long thin fingers and a trace of dried river mud at the wrist. Clothing: the robes of an elder of the River Hall, a long outer robe of river-blue silk gauze with grey-green borders embroidered in darker green and silver wave-curls, bark-cream under-layers with crossed collars, narrow sleeves, a grey-green silk sash with a small bag of lamp oil at the belt; the hem is stiff with dried river mud to the knee. Hands and objects: a small old lamp of green glass with a brass cap, lit with a steady pale flame, held in the right hand by its ring; the left hand rests on a stone dike post. Power: a thin water-blue mist of qi lies on the dike around her ankles, and tiny wood-green motes circle the lamp. Background: a dike with posts painted in ringed flood-marks, a wide river with a flat boat drifting. Light: pale noon light from the upper left, the lamp tinting her fingers and the shadow under her chin a faint green. Expression: a patient, practical, withdrawn stillness, the gaze steady and the mouth quiet, a woman who carries a small light through broad day because she once needed it.

people.imagined: In the Hall of Voices she laughs before she answers, tapping a teaching fan against her palm, remembering exactly what you told her forty years ago.
people.subject: The moment: mid-laugh in the Hall of Voices, she taps a closed fan against her palm and nods at the viewer in a knowing way, recalling exactly what you told her forty years ago. Face (a laughing mouth and bright round plump cheeks): a plump, round, rosy, quick face with a big laugh, bright black eyes crinkling into half-moons, arched brows, a double chin and deep laugh lines, with no pretence in it. Hair: black and grey, in a high round bun held by a long jade pine-twig pin and a pearl pin, a few loose curls. Body: plump, short and quick, with small quick hands, the plump fingers wearing a ring of jade. Clothing: the rich robes of the first elder, a long robe of grey-green brocade-silk with a high crossed collar and wide sleeves lined in pale blue silk, a deeper green silk sash, an over-robe of translucent grey-green gauze embroidered at the borders with darker green pine needles and silver wind-curls, a string of small white lake pearls knotted in threes at her chest and embroidered grey-green shoes. Hands and objects: a closed teaching fan of pale bamboo tapping the left palm. Power: a soft water-blue and wood-green radiance gathers about her like warm mist, and faint motes drift upward as she laughs. Background: a bright hall of tall pale pillars with rows of cross-legged students in simple robes, blurred, and a lacquered stand holding a gong. Light: warm spirit-light from the upper left brightening her round cheeks, the pearls glowing softly. Expression: a warm, sharp, forgiving laugh, the eyes bright and shrewd and the whole face sociable, a teacher who forgives everything and remembers it all.

people.imagined: On her way back from a search by the Root Hall, whole, she hides the ink-stained side of her right hand in her sleeve; the zither is on her back. She wants to be worthy.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a mist-wet stone stair with a zither on her back, her right hand drawn back into the sleeve, she looks at the viewer with determined gentleness, back from a search by the Root Hall, whole, and hiding the ink-stained side of her hand because she wants to be worthy. Face (a seven-string zither in a plain cloth case rising behind her shoulder, and the ink-stained hand tucked into the sleeve): a slight, fine-featured young face with a high forehead, serious dark eyes with a faint shadow of tiredness under them, level brows, a small firm mouth and a long neck. Hair: black, in a smooth high knot with two jade pine-twig pins and a green silk cord. Body: slight, upright and narrow-shouldered, a wide strap across the chest. Clothing: the fine robes of the named heir, three layers of flowing pine-green and bark-cream silk with crossed collars, long narrow sleeves, a needle-green silk sash with a green jade pine-cone pendant, darker green pine-needle and wind-curl embroidery at the borders, a thin line of ink-black showing at the right cuff, and a zither case of grey silk stitched with a pine-needle pattern. Hands and objects: the right hand hidden in the left sleeve while the left hand, slender and bare, rests against the strap; the pegs of the zither show above her shoulder. Power: a gentle wood-green shimmer of qi motes drifts around her, brightest near the zither, a faint water-blue gleam in her sleeve. Background: a long stone stair rising between tall pines to a pale gate in mist, small birds on the rail. Light: soft silver light from the upper left falling on her high forehead and the pegs of the zither. Expression: a stubborn, gentle diligence, the mouth soft and the eyes level, a compassionate young woman determined to deserve her place.

people.imagined: He sits very still, counting under his breath, blue-stained fingers on his knee, a small bundle of rolled flags beside him; he wants them never to be unrolled.
people.subject: The moment: sitting rigidly still in the middle of a vast chalk array with his lips moving in a silent count, he turns only his eyes to the viewer, the man who broke the ice in 904. Face (frost-white eyebrows, thick and long, over pale eyes, and blue-stained fingers): a long-boned, gaunt old face with high cheekbones, a long nose, thick eyebrows white as frost, pale grey eyes, a thin lipless mouth, deep lines, sallow skin and fine white hairs fringing his brow. His hands are long and bony and the fingers are stained blue to the second knuckle. Hair: thin white hair tied in a tight bun with a plain jade pin and a slim silver pine-twig crown-pin. Body: tall, bony, extremely still. Clothing: the rich robes of an elder of the Array Hall, a long over-robe of grey-green gauze with a high stiff collar and sleeves ending in tight cuffs bound with silver cord, under it pine-green and bark-cream silk with crossed collars, darker green borders of pine needles and array-circles embroidered in silver thread, a grey-green silk elder's sash. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on his knee with its blue-stained fingers; beside him on the floor a tight roll of small cloth flags bound with a cord. Power: a pale-blue frost of qi spreads from his body along the chalk lines, which faintly glow, tiny wood-green motes drifting above them. Background: a bare hall of tall walls, chalk lines of an enormous array crossing the floor in circles and spokes, a single barred window. Light: cold silver spirit-light from the upper left showing each chalk line sharply and leaving his face pale as paper. Expression: an unmoving, pale face of dogged patience, the eyes cold and unsparing, a man who counts the cost in other people's lives as calmly as in flags.

people.imagined: At dawn on the north shore she counts the skiffs across the water with a bronze mirror at her hip, wind in her face.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a windy shore at dawn with a hand shading her eyes, she turns a sharp, amused look on the viewer, counting the skiffs across the water. Face (a round burnished bronze mirror at the hip catching the light, and a wind-burned face): a short, square, wind-burned face with deep creases from squinting, bright shrewd black eyes, thick brows, a wide humorous mouth, chapped red cheeks and small ears. Hair: black and iron-grey, in a thick short braid tied with sealskin cord and a jade bead. Body: short, solid and broad-shouldered, with square callused hands from oars. Clothing: the rich robes of an elder, a dark glossy sealskin cloak fastened with a bone toggle and rimed with salt at the cuff, over a long grey-green brocade-silk robe with crossed collars and darker green wave and pine-needle embroidery at the borders, a grey-green silk sash with a coil of signal cord at the belt, a green jade pine-cone pendant and fur-lined boots laced with sinew. Hands and objects: the left hand shading her eyes; at the right hip a round polished bronze hand-mirror on a cord, flashing the dawn. Power: a faint water-blue shimmer of qi rises off the lake and curls about her shoulders, drifting spray glittering in it. Background: a vast pale lake stretching to a faint far shore beneath a line of grey cliffs, little skiffs lying like specks on the water. Light: cold pink dawn light from the upper left tinting the water, the bronze mirror throwing a tiny spark. Expression: an amused, pragmatic, sociable look, one brow lifted and the mouth wide, a woman who has watched this water for thirty years and enjoys being right about it.

people.imagined: He works the abacus of pine-nut beads without looking, eyes on the treasury roll in his head. He knows to the coin how poor seven vassals are.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk in a quiet counting room, his fingers flicking an abacus without looking down, his eyes on the viewer, calm and precise. Face (an abacus of brown pine-nut beads, flicked by quick fingers): a neat, round, clean-shaven face with a high rounded forehead, gentle exact grey eyes, a small neat nose, a small mouth with a patient pursed look and smooth cheeks; his fingers are short and plump and quick on the beads, and a neat line of tiredness runs under his eyes. Hair: black with grey at the temples, in a tidy topknot with a grey-green cord and a jade pin. Body: round, tidy, straight-backed. Clothing: the rich robes of the palace steward, a long robe of pine-green brocade-silk over bark-cream layers with crossed collars, spotless white cuffs, a grey-green gauze over-robe with darker green pine-needle borders embroidered in silver, a grey-green silk sash held by a small copper clasp, with a seal pouch and a thin silk cord at his belt and a green jade pine-cone pendant. Hands and objects: both hands on a wooden abacus whose beads are brown pine nuts; beside it a small iron strongbox. Power: a few faint wood-green motes float above the beads like dust in sunlight, and a soft earth-gold glint lies in the strongbox's lock. Background: a quiet counting room with shelves of tidy ledgers, a locked iron strongbox, a window shuttered half closed. Light: soft pearly light from the upper left, the polished beads gleaming and a gentle rim along his topknot. Expression: a calm, precise face with a still mouth and cautious, level eyes that never look at his hands.

people.imagined: In the deep pines in the evening he wears the tiger-skin half-cape, claw marks still through it, and holds a name he is trying to learn the owner of.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a dark pine wood in the evening, he looks at the viewer with a hard, scarred, impatient stare, his half-cape lifting, holding a name he is trying to learn the owner of. Face (a tiger-skin half-cape on the left shoulder, striped orange and black, with four long claw slits cut through it): a lean, scarred, hawkish face with long pale claw scars across the left cheek and brow, hooded dark eyes, a straight nose, a tight jaw, a short grey-streaked beard and a thin white scar across the throat. Hair: black and grey, tied in a tight knot with a leather cord and a silver pin. Body: lean, wiry and upright, the neck cabled with sinew. Clothing: the rich robes of a captain-elder, the tiger-skin half-cape kept as a trophy, fastened with a bone pin over a long coat of dark pine-green brocade-silk with crossed collars and darker green pine-needle embroidery, a grey-green silk sash, silver-chased leather bracers, a long grey-green gauze over-robe cut for riding, long grey boots and a leather quiver at his back. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on the haft of a long spear with a broad leaf-shaped blade, planted in the ground, the knuckles scarred. Power: a dense wood-green glow of qi gathers round the spear's blade, and thin motes of green light follow him between the trunks. Background: tall dark pines receding into pale mist, a trail of paw marks in damp earth and a crow on a branch. Light: low gold light from the upper left catching the striped fur and the edge of the blade, a faint silver mist at his feet. Expression: a hard, impatient, loyal stare, the jaw tight and the eyes hooded, a brave hunter with the stillness of a man who waits only as long as he must.

people.imagined: Barefoot on the cold sand, salt in his beard, he looks at the tide as if it were a student; he means one day to walk out.
people.subject: The moment: standing barefoot at the waterline with the tide washing his ankles, he looks at the viewer with calm, remote eyes, at the cold sea as if it were a student, meaning one day to walk out. Face (a long white beard stiff with salt, and bare feet in the surf): a gaunt, long, weathered face with high cheekbones, pale deep-set eyes, thick grey brows and chapped lips; the beard is crusted white with salt. Hair: grey, long and loose, damp with spray, held at the crown by a slender jade pine-twig crown-pin. Body: gaunt, tall and long-boned, with bony hands cracked by salt, bare pale feet and white salt dusting the shoulders. Clothing: the rich robes of an elder, a long layered robe of pale grey-green gauze over bark-cream silk with wide flowing sleeves and a narrow grey-green silk sash, collars crossed three times, darker green wave and pine-needle embroidery at the borders, bleached with salt in white tide-lines at the hem and damp from the surf, a bit of dried seaweed caught in the sash. Hands and objects: both hands hang loose at his sides; a small white shell on a cord at his neck. Power: a sea-blue shimmer of qi hovers near his open hands, and a slow ring of pale light spreads over the water around his feet with every wave. Background: a silvery sea with slow waves rolling in white lines, a wide beach running to a far headland and an empty pavilion with a tiled roof on a rise, a drift of sea-mist. Light: cold silver moonlit light from the upper left, soft on his skin, the wet sand shining. Expression: a calm, remote, devout stillness, the eyes pale and unblinking and the mouth closed, a solitary man who is listening to the tide and who is almost ready.

people.imagined: She lifts a hand to show the soot under her nails; her sleeves smell of agarwood and cold plum. She wants one stick to burn an extra breath.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a garden court, one long sleeve held out toward the viewer as if offering its scent, her other hand showing a fingertip black with soot. Face: a tall, graceful, pale, fine-boned face with a long nose, calm slanted dark eyes, thin elegant brows, a small patient smile and a smudge of soot at the temple; her hands are long and slim, the nails edged black with soot. Hair: black, in a high coil with two jade pine-twig pins, a pale plum blossom tucked in it. Body: unhurried and willowy. Clothing: the rich robes of the Incense Hall's keeper, a long robe of pale pine-green brocade-silk over bark-cream layers with crossed collars, wide sleeves lined in plum-pink silk, a translucent grey-green gauze over-robe embroidered in darker green and silver with pine needles and curling smoke, a grey-green silk elder's sash, a thin cord of black soot-stained cotton wound about the left wrist, and soft pale slippers. Hands and objects: the left sleeve held out; the right hand holds a slim unlit incense stick, fingernails visibly black with soot. Power: a thread of wood-green qi-light rises from the unlit stick like invisible smoke, and a faint plum scent seems to shimmer about her sleeves in soft petals of light. Background: a garden court with a stone path and small bare plum trees, a thread of grey smoke curling up from a low brazier into mist. Light: soft, clear, cool spirit-light from the upper left glowing on the pink lining of the sleeve. Expression: a serene, patient face with lowered lids and a faint gentle smile, soft and unhurried.

people.imagined: She pours tea for everyone before she lets them speak, in river-blue silk; she has not forgiven a smile.
people.subject: The moment: pouring tea from a small pot with a gracious sweep of the arm, she smiles warmly at the viewer, pouring for everyone before she lets them speak, in river-blue silk, having never forgiven a smile. Face (a river-blue silk robe and a warm hostess's smile over unforgiving eyes): a handsome, composed, round-cheeked face with bright long almond eyes that hold steady and cold while the smile stays on, arched brows, full lips painted pale rose and a small beauty mark by the mouth. Hair: black, in a tall elegant coil with silver pins and a small pine-green jade. Body: shapely, composed and upright, with graceful pale hands and a jade bangle on the left wrist. Clothing: the rich robes of the envoy, a long robe of river-blue brocade-silk with a high crossed collar and wide sleeves, embroidered along the hem with a thin silver wave and darker green pine-needle borders, a translucent grey-green gauze over-robe trailing behind her, a grey-green sash tied in a flat elegant bow and soft silver-grey slippers. Hands and objects: a small grey clay teapot in the right hand pouring into a tiny cup held in the left, with a thin thread of steam. Power: a faint water-blue glow gathers on the surface of the tea and in the folds of her sleeves, tiny wood-green motes drifting through the steam. Background: a pale hall with a low lacquered table, cushions, a second cup waiting and a screen painted only in soft grey. Light: warm light from the upper left shining on the silk and the stream of tea and leaving her eyes in a cool shade. Expression: a gracious, practised smile on the mouth with the eyes level and cold above it, the warmth of a hostess who is keeping a long account.

people.imagined: At the dusk listening she sings her son's name under her breath; a patrolman's wooden token hangs at her neck, river silt on her boots.
people.subject: The moment: standing at dusk on a dike, her lips parted as if singing very low, a hand closed round a wooden token at her neck, looking at the viewer. Face (a small round wooden patrolman's token on a cord at her neck, gripped in her fist): a broad, strong, grey-haired woman's face, deep lines, tired grey eyes, a stubborn chin, a calm mouth shaped in a hum; sorrow held in. Her hands are broad and red with cracked knuckles, her lids heavy, her lips dry. Hair: grey, in a tight low bun with a plain jade pine-twig pin. Body: sturdy, square, upright. Clothing: the robes of the second of the River Hall, a long robe of grey-green silk over bark-cream layers with crossed collars, a river-blue gauze over-robe with darker green wave and pine-needle embroidery at the borders, a grey-green sash mended with a strip of different cloth, sleeves tied back, grey river silt dusting her boots and hem, and a faded blue scarf at her neck. Hands and objects: the right hand closed round a round flat wooden token on a cord at her breast; the left rests on a dike post. Power: a soft water-blue shimmer of qi rises from the river and lies against the hem of her robe, brightest around the token in her fist. Background: a long dike running into a dusk haze, the river a wide pale band, small lights from a village. Light: low gold dusk light from the upper left resting on her grey hair and the small wooden token in her fist. Expression: a patient, stubborn face with lips parted in a murmur and tired, tender eyes on the viewer.

people.imagined: He stands at the fence of the grey pine vein in a cloak the colour of the pines, with a small cord of tokens in his hand, watching the border.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a wooden fence on a hillside, he looks suspiciously over it toward the border, then at the viewer. Face: a dark, square, hard face with a heavy brow, narrow suspicious dark eyes, a short thick black beard, a straight nose and a hard mouth, a faint grey tint at the temples; his hands are square with short thick fingers, his neck thick, and a faint line of grey dust lies in the creases of his brow. Hair: black with a few grey hairs, in a short topknot with an iron-grey jade pin. Body: stocky, broad and square. Clothing: the rich robes of the warden, a long cloak the exact dull grey of pine trunks, clasped with a silver pin, over a coat of dark pine-green brocade-silk with a collar of dark grey silk and bark-cream under-layers, darker green pine-needle embroidery at the borders, a grey-green silk sash, silver-studded leather gauntlets, iron-shod boots and a short knife on his belt. Hands and objects: a string of small brown tokens, each tied with a knot, held up in the right hand; the left grips the fence post. Power: a faint iron-grey glint of metal qi runs along his gauntlets, and a pale wood-green haze clings to the cloak. Background: a line of weathered grey fence posts running over a dark ridge, bare tall pine trunks in the mist, a pale sky. Light: cold silver light from the upper left, flat and suited to the grey of everything, his dark face the only warm thing. Expression: a narrowed, suspicious stare with a furrowed brow and a tight mouth, the head turning from the border to the viewer.

people.imagined: In the Pill Room he lifts a hand to show orange-stained fingertips; one eyebrow is singed away; he holds two hundred recipes in his head and he is afraid of forgetting.
people.subject: The moment: stooped over a furnace he lifts one hand with orange-stained fingertips and gives the viewer a kind, tired smile. Face (orange-stained fingertips, and one eyebrow singed away, leaving the face lopsided): a long, gentle, tired face with a high forehead, one thick eyebrow on the left and none on the right, warm brown eyes, a drooping moustache and a shy smile; his fingertips are bright orange, his ears long, the remaining eyebrow thin and grey, with a tiny scorch scar on his temple. Hair: grey, thin, in a small knot with a jade pine-twig pin. Body: stooped, thin, long-armed. Clothing: the rich robes of the Pill Room's master, a long robe of grey-green brocade-silk over bark-cream layers with crossed collars, darker green pine-needle embroidery at the borders and cuffs stained orange, a grey-green silk sash and a pill-maker's apron of fine grey cloth with many small pockets full of tiny twists of paper with no writing, and felt slippers. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted, fingertips bright orange; the left holds a tiny clay jar. Power: a few warm red-gold sparks and wood-green motes of pill-qi drift up from the furnace mouth and curl round his lifted fingers. Background: a small furnace room of shelves with rows of small clay jars sealed with wax, a little iron stove glowing red at the corner, herbs hung from the beam, a haze of fragrant steam. Light: warm light from the lower right and soft pale light from the upper left, the warm light glowing on his bald patch and lighting the orange of his fingers like embers. Expression: a kind, tired smile with crinkled eyes and one singed brow, a flicker of worry behind the gentleness.

people.imagined: Memorial of the founder in the year 200, a hermit sitting alone in the pine sea, listening, about to found a palace he never intended to make so large.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of the founder as an aged hermit seated alone under a great pine in the year 200, listening with his eyes shut, about to found a palace he never meant to make so large. Face: a long, lean, weathered face with a straight nose, a long white beard in a point, deep creases, closed eyes with heavy lids and a calm patient mouth with the faintest ambitious set; the skin of his face is lined like pine bark. Hair: long white hair, tied up in a loose knot with a bare pine twig and a pale jade pin. Body: lean, upright, seated cross-legged, his long thin hands laid open on his knees. Clothing: the robes of an immortal hermit, flowing layers of pale pine-green and bark-cream gauze with wide sleeves and crossed collars, plain and loose with no sash of rank, a coarse hemp rope belt knotted simply, a faint border of darker green pine needles at the hem, the hem covered in fallen needles. Hands and objects: both hands lie on the knees, palms up; a few pine needles fallen on his shoulders. Power: a faint wood-green haze of qi rises from his shoulders, motes of pale light floating up among the needles as if the forest were listening back. Background: a dense pine sea, enormous trunks fading into soft mist in every direction. Light: a thin shaft of faint gold from the upper left through the canopy, the paint fading like old silk and cracked in a fine web, the edges brown and soft, his face a pale oval. Expression: a patient, withdrawn face with closed lips and eyes shut in stillness, a quiet pride beneath.

people.imagined: Memorial of the governor on his quay in 905, refusing to go, lantern beside him, stubborn and loyal.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a stern governor standing on a stone quay at night beside a lit lantern. Face (a thin, long, straight nose and a cold stubborn mouth): a lean, hard, aristocratic face with a long thin straight nose, narrow dark eyes, thin lips set, a long grey beard in a neat point, high cheekbones and a small mole on the right temple; his hands are bony and veined. Hair: black-grey, tied in a high official knot with a black jade pin. Body: tall, straight and stiff, with square shoulders. Clothing: the robes of the governor-elder, a long dark over-robe of heavy silk with a broad black collar edged in grey-green, over layers of pine-green and bark-cream silk with crossed collars, darker green pine-needle embroidery at the borders, a heavy grey-green sash, a plain green stone seal carved as a coiled pine at his belt and black cloth boots. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on the head of a tall unlit staff; at his feet a paper lantern burning. Power: a faint wood-green shimmer of qi surrounds the seal and rises in thin motes round his shoulders, dimmed by the age of the painting. Background: a stone quay of massive grey stones, black water lapping below, the dim shape of a boat at a mooring post and a far shore lost in mist. Light: lantern glow from the lower left that looks like a faded amber stain, the yellowed silk darkened at the corners, the paint cracked. Expression: a stern, unmoving face with a set jaw and steady eyes lit by the lantern, the mouth hard.

people.imagined: Memorial of the smith standing on the thousand-fathom chain as the fort breaks, hammer in hand, the iron streak in him barely taken by the canon.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a big smith standing on a huge iron chain with a hammer in hand, looking calm and stubborn. Face: a broad, heavy, soot-browned face with a flat nose, a thick black beard braided at the chin, bright determined eyes, thick brows and a scar across the cheek; his forearms are thick and burn-scarred, his hair singed at the ends, and a spark-scar dots the bridge of his nose. Hair: black, tied up under a plain cap of dark silk with a small jade pin. Body: broad, muscular, shoulders like a bull. Clothing: the robes of a master-craftsman elder, a jerkin of dark pine-green silk with crossed collars over bark-cream sleeves cut off at the shoulder, a scorched smith's apron of fine grey cloth with a long split at the hem, darker green pine-needle embroidery along the collar, a grey-green silk cord at the waist, iron-capped boots and a silver-studded wrist guard on each arm, the forearms burn-scarred. Hands and objects: a heavy smith's hammer held head-down in both hands; beneath his feet a massive iron chain, each link as big as a man's torso, going into a dark river. Power: faint silver-grey sparks of metal qi cling to the hammer head and the links of the chain. Background: a river gorge, a broken fortress wall and drifting mist. Light: dim light from the upper left, the chain's links picked out in pale highlights, the yellowed silk cracked across the iron and the edges dark with age. Expression: a strong, stubborn face with a set jaw and steady eyes, brows lowered in effort.

people.imagined: Memorial of the River Hall master laying a sluice array on the quay, calm and pragmatic, in the year of the great flood.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of an old formation master crouching on a quay to set a small stone flag into a sluice in the year of the great flood. Face: a lean, careful, deeply lined face with a high forehead, a long nose, sharp patient eyes, a faint practical frown and a thin sparse white beard with a few drops of river water on it; his hands are thin and tough with swollen knuckles. Hair: white, tied in a plain knot with a slender jade pin. Body: wiry and bent. Clothing: the robes of the River Hall's master, a long robe of pine-green and bark-cream silk soaked dark at the hem, crossed collars with darker green wave and pine-needle borders, a grey-green elder's silk sash with a knotted measuring cord hanging from it, a thin grey-green gauze over-robe with the sleeves tied up, and plain wooden clogs. Hands and objects: both hands set a small triangular stone flag into a gap in a sluice wall; a heap of such flags beside him. Power: a faint water-blue glow of formation qi runs between the flags in thin lines, as if the half-finished array were already breathing. Background: a stone quay with a swollen river running close to its edge, a line of small stone flags marking a half-finished array behind him, mist over the water. Light: pale grey light from the upper left, the yellowed silk faded at the corners so that the grey looks painted in thin washes. Expression: a pragmatic, cautious diligence, the frown small and the eyes on the work, an old master who has measured the flood and is not going to be hurried by it.

people.imagined: Memorial of the patrolman on the Cold Ford ice in 1172, sled behind him, loyal, honest, his deep cleft chin showing.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a patrolman standing on ice with a sled rope in his hand, looking calmly forward. Face (a deep cleft chin, a straight mouth): a lean, strong, calm face with a deep cleft in the chin, level dark eyes, straight brows, a short beard line and wind-reddened cheekbones with a thin frost clinging to the beard; his hands are strong and gloved in leather. Hair: black, in a knot with a grey-green silk cord and a jade pin. Body: tall, strong, steady. Clothing: a patrolman's short coat of pine-green silk quilted for the cold with a fur collar pale at the edges, over bark-cream layers with crossed collars, darker green pine-needle borders, silver-studded leather bracers, a needle-green silk sash, and a plain round wooden disc, unmarked, hung at his neck on a green cord that is also wound round his sword hilt. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a rope trailing off to a sled; the left rests on the hilt of a sword. Power: a thin cold wood-green haze of qi gathers about his shoulders and a few pale water-blue motes drift off the ice. Background: a flat grey ice plain with a single sled, a line of reeds at the edge and a pale ghost of the far shore. Light: pale cold light from the upper left, the yellowed silk darkened at the corners so the light looks like a faded wash of grey-blue. Expression: a brave, honest face looking straight ahead with a firm mouth and the deep cleft chin plain.

people.imagined: Memorial of the son on the last rope bridge, a blade in his hand, about to cut the final rope, impatient and brave.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a young-looking man on a swaying rope bridge raising a black blade to cut the last rope. Face (a broad fisher's jaw like his father's and a fierce impatient glare): a broad, handsome, weathered face with a square jaw, dark fierce eyes, thick brows, a flared nose, a short black beard and a thick white scar across the chin. Hair: black, tied in a high knot with a jade pin and windblown. Body: broad, strong and braced, with heavy shoulders and calloused palms. Clothing: the robes of a patrolman-captain, a short coat of pine-green silk with crossed collars over bark-cream layers, darker green wave and pine-needle embroidery at the borders, a needle-green silk sash, silver-studded leather bracers, and a green cord tied about the hilt of a second knife at his belt, the loose sleeves whipping in the wind. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted with a black flying blade, its edge down toward a thick rope; the left holds a bridge rope. Power: a hard wood-green glow of qi runs along the black blade and a cold water-blue mist streams from the gorge round his boots. Background: a pale rope bridge stretching over a deep river gorge with a few planks missing, a river far below and mist rising. Light: pale light from the upper left, the yellowed silk cracked at the corners and faded like old paint, a thin silver gleam on the edge of the blade. Expression: a fierce, impatient glare, the jaw clenched and the eyes locked on the rope, brave and loyal, a man who has already decided what he will cut and what he will save.

people.imagined: Memorial of the first steward of the north in 345, laying a warm stone onto a village house with his own hands, generous and humble.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a kind steward in a snowy lake village setting a flat stone with both hands onto a low wall. Face: a round, warm, humble face with a broad smile, bright small eyes, thick grey-black brows, a short beard, ruddy cheeks and stone dust on his brow; his hands are broad and chapped, stone dust in the lines of his knuckles, and his round cheeks are red with cold. Hair: black with grey, in a plain knot under a straw hat. Body: stocky, strong, a little bent. Clothing: the robes of the first steward, a long robe of pine-green and bark-cream silk with sleeves rolled to the elbow, crossed collars, darker green pine-needle embroidery at the hem, a grey-green elder's silk sash, a heavy mason's apron grey with dust over it, boots wrapped in cloth against the snow and a small hammer at his belt on a green cord. Hands and objects: both hands hold a flat grey stone as if setting it into a wall; behind him a half-built house of stone, with a small fire glowing in its hearth. Power: a soft earth-gold and wood-green shimmer of qi sits on the stone in his hands and seems to settle it into place. Background: a lake village in snow, small low houses of grey stone with smoking chimneys along the shore, a few villagers carrying stones, blurred. Light: warm light from the upper left and from the hearth, the yellowed silk soft and brown at the edges, the glow like a faded orange stain. Expression: a warm, humble face with soft eyes lowered to the stone and a gentle, generous smile.
